title: Deep learning the dynamic regulatory sequence code of cardiac organoid differentiation.
authors: Metzl-Raz, Eyal; Zhao, Ryan; Deshpande, Salil; Powell, Jackson; Porter, Elizabeth G; Zouaghi, Yassine; Liu, Betty B; Kim, Samuel H; Abdi, Immanuel; Evergreen, Ivy; Agarwal, Megha; Sheth, Maya U; Rico, Joshua; Miyamoto, Matthew; Sanchez, Julie M; Engreitz, Jesse M; Kundaje, Anshul; Greenleaf, William J; Gifford, Casey A
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文结合单细胞多组学与深度学习预测染色质可及性，解析心脏类器官分化中TF-DNA调控语法，虽非直接建模TF-DNA互作机制，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测研究。
abstract: Defining the temporal gene regulatory programs that drive human organogenesis is essential for understanding the origins of congenital disease. We combined a time-resolved, single-cell multi-omic atlas of human iPSC-derived cardiac organoids with deep learning models that predict chromatin accessibility from DNA sequence, enabling the discovery of the regulatory syntax underlying early heart development. This framework uncovered cell-state-specific rules of cardiogenesis, including context-dependent activities of TEAD, HAND, and TBX transcription factor families, and linked these motifs to their target genes. We identified distinct programs guiding lineage divergence, such as ventricular versus pacemaker cardiomyocytes, and validated predictions by perturbing Myocardin (MYOCD), establishing its essential role in ventricular specification. Integration of chromatin, transcriptional, and genetic data further highlighted regulatory regions and disease-associated variants that perturb differentiation state transitions, supporting evidence that suggests congenital heart disease emerges early in development. This work bridges developmental gene regulation with disease genetics, providing a foundation for mechanistic and therapeutic insights into congenital diseases.
abstract_zh: 定义驱动人类器官发生的时序基因调控程序，对于理解先天性疾病的起源至关重要。我们将人类iPSC来源的心脏类器官的时间分辨单细胞多组学图谱与从DNA序列预测染色质可及性的深度学习模型相结合，从而发现了早期心脏发育背后的调控语法。该框架揭示了心肌发生的细胞状态特异性规则，包括TEAD、HAND和TBX转录因子家族的上下文依赖性活性，并将这些基序与其靶基因联系起来。我们识别了指导谱系分化的不同程序，例如心室肌细胞与起搏器心肌细胞，并通过扰动Myocardin (MYOCD)验证了预测，确立了其在心室特化中的关键作用。染色质、转录和遗传数据的整合进一步突出了调控区域和疾病相关变异，这些变异干扰分化状态转变，支持了先天性心脏病在发育早期出现的证据。这项工作将发育基因调控与疾病遗传学联系起来，为先天性疾病的机制和治疗见解提供了基础。
